The bill would have imposed penalties on secret recorders and required them to disclose the identities of the recorded subjects.

The bill would have banned the secret recording of individuals in public places.
The bill called for the secret recorders to reveal the identities of those they secretly recorded.
articles.insight: This veto indicates the complexities of legislating privacy in the era of ubiquitous personal recording devices. Balancing privacy rights with freedom of information is a challenge faced by lawmakers.
